items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: and then we have a benefit concert with Oscar Peterson

ctx.x: Yeah. Like next week I’m working at the Knickerbocker and the week after I’m working at Zinno’s. I do Zinno’s quite a bit with Junior. And we have a couple of concerts at Lincoln Center, an Ellington concert and then we have a benefit concert with Oscar Peterson, and then a Sidney Bechet concert. And I took on some things to work at Cafe Carlyle with Bobby Short. So I’m really busy until the end of the year, until the middle of January. And then I go on this tour, we start rehearsing for this tour, which takes me…
I was just going to ask if you ever have occasion to get back to Scotland.
